option_a_local_notifications_only.description: Native OS-level local scheduled reminders using AlarmManager/NotificationManager on Android and UNUserNotificationCenter on iOS.
pros: Zero server infrastructure or API dependency
Works 100% offline and in airplane mode after scheduling
Zero battery drain from background location or polling
Zero third-party vendor lock-in (no Firebase/OneSignal/APNs server certs)
cons: Cannot receive server-pushed dynamic cancellations if transit network changes mid-route

option_b_local_plus_remote_push.description: Local alarms plus server-side push registration foundation.
pros: Prepares for future real-time tracking if operators publish telemetry
cons: No backend push endpoints or APNs/FCM keys exist in repo
Requires invasive device token registration plumbing

option_c_remote_push_first.description: All departure reminders scheduled on server and delivered via push.
cons: Fails completely when device is offline in transit dead zones
Forces account sign-in to associate push tokens
High server operational overhead without benefits

rationale: O-TRAVELZ is a local-first atlas. Scheduled transit departures are static deterministic facts from CRUT/Mo Bus timetables. Scheduling on-device guarantees reminders fire even in poor cellular connectivity without account gates.
